title: LÊ THÁNH TÔNG
sub: That year, Đại Việt's emperor Lê Thánh Tông led a large army south against Vijaya.
say: That year, Dye Vee-et's emperor Lay Tahn Tong led a large army south against Vee-jaya.

title: THE CITY FELL
sub: The city fell. The Cham king, called Trà Toàn in Vietnamese records, was captured with his family.
say: The city fell. The Chahm king, called Chah Twahn in Vietnamese records, was captured with his family.

title: VIETNAMESE CHRONICLE
sub: The Vietnamese court chronicle claims over 40,000 killed and over 30,000 captured. Those are its own figures, not a settled count.
say: The Vietnamese court chronicle claims over forty thousand killed and over thirty thousand captured. Those are its own figures, not a settled count.

title: MING HISTORY
sub: The Ming history, written in China, records the king and more than fifty of his relatives taken away.
say: The Ming history, written in China, records the king and more than fifty of his relatives taken away.

title: WHAT DID CHINA DO?
